svg.title: Charges in a volume Ax of wire
svg.desc: Charges q drift to the right with drift velocity v_d through a wire of cross-sectional area A. All the charges in the shaded volume Ax, between the cross section at the left and the dashed cross section a distance x = v_d t to its right, pass through the right-hand cross section in time t. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Counting charge through a wire cross section

I = 2.00 A; n = 8.5 × 10²⁸ m⁻³; A = 1 mm²; v drift ≈ 0.147 mm/s
Each dot represents many positive carriers; displayed drift is enlarged. During 1 s, 2 C crosses the
area. This is carrier transport, not signal speed.
